# `lakana row-filter`

run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana row-filter [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Manage row filters.

## `lakana row-filter create`

Usage: `lakana row-filter create [OPTIONS] {table}`

Restrict which rows of TABLE (namespace.table) a principal or group sees.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TABLE` | text | required |  |
| `--expression` | text | required | Restricted SQL expression. |
| `--principal` | text | none | Principal name. |
| `--group` | text | none | Group name. |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--override-managed` | flag | off | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency (needs ADMIN on the instance; audited; the next apply reverts it). |
| `--reason` | text | none | Why, 10-500 characters on one line (with --override-managed). |

## `lakana row-filter list`

Usage: `lakana row-filter list [OPTIONS]`

List active row filters, optionally filtered.

The table names who each row filter is for in `subject`. When the terminal is too narrow it leaves out `environment`, `id`, `namespace` and `bound`, in that order; `--output json` always has every field.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | text | none | Principal name. |
| `--group` | text | none | Group name. |
| `--env` | text | none | Only this environment. |

## `lakana row-filter revoke`

Usage: `lakana row-filter revoke [OPTIONS] {row_filter_id}`

Revoke row filter ROW_FILTER_ID.

Take the id from `row-filter list`; on a narrow terminal the table leaves it out, so widen the terminal or use `--output json`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROW_FILTER_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--override-managed` | flag | off | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency (needs ADMIN on the instance; audited; the next apply reverts it). |
| `--reason` | text | none | Why, 10-500 characters on one line (with --override-managed). |
